overview.en: Pediatric cardiovascular nursing: hyperlipidemia, heart failure (HF) and digoxin/diuretic care, congenital heart defects grouped by blood-flow effect, cardiac catheterization and surgery care, rheumatic fever, and Kawasaki disease.
overview.zh: 兒童心血管護理：高血脂、心衰竭（HF）與毛地黃/利尿劑照護、依血流影響分類的先天性心臟缺損、心導管與心臟手術護理、風濕熱與川崎病。

points.en: Ages 2-19: total cholesterol <170 mg/dL acceptable, 170-199 borderline, >=200 high.
points.zh: 2-19歲：總膽固醇 <170 mg/dL 為可接受，170-199 為臨界，≥200 為偏高。

points.en: LDL <110 acceptable, 110-129 borderline, >=130 high; HDL >45 acceptable, <40 low.
points.zh: LDL <110 可接受，110-129 臨界，≥130 偏高；HDL >45 可接受，<40 偏低。

points.en: Triglycerides: <100 mg/dL (age <=9) or <130 mg/dL (age >=10) is acceptable.
points.zh: 三酸甘油酯：9歲以下 <100 mg/dL，10歲以上 <130 mg/dL 為可接受。

points.en: Childhood hyperlipidemia tends to persist and raises later cardiac event risk; any elevation warrants cardiology referral.
points.zh: 兒童期高血脂常持續至成年並增加心臟事件風險；任何異常升高皆應轉介心臟科。

points.en: Treatment centers on diet, physical activity and behavior change.
points.zh: 治療以飲食、身體活動與行為改變為主。

points.en: HF = heart cannot meet the body's metabolic/oxygen needs; in children usually from congenital defects causing volume or pressure overload; both sides typically fail together.
points.zh: HF指心臟無法供應身體代謝與氧需求；兒童多因先天缺損造成容積或壓力負荷過重，通常左右心同時衰竭。

points.en: Early signs: tachycardia (even at rest), tachypnea, profuse scalp sweating in infants, fatigue, irritability, sudden weight gain, respiratory distress.
points.zh: 早期徵象：休息時心跳過速、呼吸過速、嬰兒頭皮大量出汗、疲倦易怒、體重突然增加、呼吸窘迫。

points.en: Left-sided: crackles, cough, dyspnea, grunting, nasal flaring, retractions, orthopnea. Right-sided: hepatosplenomegaly, JVD, peripheral/periorbital edema, ascites, oliguria, weight gain.
points.zh: 左心衰：囉音、咳嗽、呼吸困難、呻吟、鼻翼搧動、肋間凹陷。右心衰：肝脾腫大、頸靜脈怒張、周邊/眼周水腫、腹水、少尿、體重增加。

heading.en: Heart failure: nursing care and medications

points.en: Count apical pulse and respirations for a full minute; strict I&O (weigh diapers); daily weight, same scale/time; 0.5 kg (1 lb) gain in a day suggests fluid retention.
points.zh: 心尖脈與呼吸需測滿1分鐘；嚴格I&O（秤尿布）；每日同一體重計、同一時間量體重，一天增加0.5 kg代表液體滯留。

points.en: Semi-Fowler position, cool humidified oxygen, neutral thermal environment, cluster care for rest, small frequent feedings.
points.zh: 半坐臥、冷濕化氧氣、維持中性溫度、集中護理讓其休息、少量多餐。

points.en: Digoxin: hold if apical rate <90-110 (infants/young children) or <70 (older children); therapeutic level 0.8-2 ng/mL; toxicity signs are anorexia, poor feeding, N/V, bradycardia, dysrhythmias.
points.zh: 毛地黃：心尖脈嬰幼兒 <90-110、較大兒童 <70 時暫停給藥；治療濃度0.8-2 ng/mL；中毒徵象為厭食、拒食、噁心嘔吐、心搏過緩、心律不整。

points.en: Furosemide causes hypokalemia (K+ <3.5), which potentiates digoxin toxicity; give potassium only if indicated and renal function is adequate.
points.zh: furosemide可致低血鉀（K+ <3.5），會加重毛地黃中毒；需有適應症且腎功能良好才補鉀。

points.en: ACE inhibitors: watch for hypotension, renal dysfunction, cough.
points.zh: ACE抑制劑：注意低血壓、腎功能異常、咳嗽。

points.en: Parents learn digoxin home care and CPR.
points.zh: 需教導家長在家給予毛地黃及CPR。

heading.en: Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow

points.en: Left-to-right shunts (ASD, VSD, PDA, AV canal): blood moves from high-pressure left side to right; signs of HF.
points.zh: 左向右分流（ASD、VSD、PDA、房室管缺損）：血液由高壓左側流向右側，出現HF徵象。

points.en: ASD: opening between atria; may be asymptomatic; closed by catheter or open repair, usually before school age.
points.zh: ASD：心房間開口；可無症狀；可經心導管或開心手術修補，多在學齡前完成。

points.en: AV canal defect: incomplete endocardial cushion fusion; most common defect in Down syndrome.
points.zh: 房室管缺損：心內膜墊融合不全；唐氏症最常見之心臟缺損。

points.en: PDA: machinery-like murmur, widened pulse pressure, bounding pulses; indomethacin closes it in premature infants; prostaglandin E keeps it open in ductal-dependent lesions.
points.zh: PDA：機械樣雜音、脈壓增寬、脈搏洪大；indomethacin可使早產兒導管關閉；導管依賴型缺損用前列腺素E維持導管開放。

points.en: VSD: many small/moderate defects close spontaneously in the first year; HF common.
points.zh: VSD：許多小至中型缺損在第一年自行閉合；常見HF。

points.en: Aortic stenosis: narrowed aortic valve; LV hypertrophy; children have activity intolerance, chest pain, dizziness; treated with balloon dilation or valvotomy.
points.zh: 主動脈瓣狹窄：瓣膜狹窄、左心室肥大；兒童活動耐受不良、胸痛、頭暈；以氣球擴張或瓣膜切開術治療。

points.en: Coarctation of the aorta: BP higher in arms than legs, bounding arm pulses, weak/absent femoral pulses, cool legs; headache, epistaxis, dizziness.
points.zh: 主動脈縮窄：上肢血壓高於下肢、上肢脈搏洪大、股動脈脈搏弱或消失、下肢冰冷；頭痛、流鼻血、頭暈。

points.en: Coarctation repair is outside the heart: thoracotomy, no cardiopulmonary bypass.
points.zh: 縮窄修補位於心臟外：開胸，不需體外循環。

points.en: Pulmonary stenosis: right ventricular hypertrophy, decreased pulmonary flow; severe cases cyanotic in newborns; treated by dilation or valvotomy.
points.zh: 肺動脈瓣狹窄：右心室肥大、肺血流減少；嚴重者新生兒發紺；以擴張或瓣膜切開治療。

heading.en: Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow

points.en: Right-to-left shunts cause hypoxemia and cyanosis.
points.zh: 右向左分流造成低血氧與發紺。

points.en: Tetralogy of Fallot: VSD, pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, RV hypertrophy.
points.zh: 法洛氏四重症：VSD、肺動脈狹窄、主動脈騎跨、右心室肥大。

points.en: Tet spells occur with crying, feeding, defecating; older children squat and develop clubbing and poor growth.
points.zh: 哭泣、餵食、排便時可出現缺氧發作（tet spell）；較大兒童會蹲踞、杵狀指、生長遲緩。

points.en: Management: palliative shunt in infants who cannot have primary repair; complete repair in the first year via sternotomy and bypass.
points.zh: 處置：無法一次修補的嬰兒先做姑息性分流；第一年內以胸骨切開與體外循環完全修補。

points.en: Tricuspid atresia: no RA-to-RV connection; blood passes through ASD/PFO and VSD; cyanosis, clubbing.
points.zh: 三尖瓣閉鎖：右心房與右心室無相通；血液經ASD/PFO與VSD；發紺、杵狀指。

points.en: Hypoplastic left heart: hypoplastic LV and aortic atresia; deteriorates as the ductus closes; needs prostaglandin E1 and ventilation before surgery.
points.zh: 左心發育不全：左心室發育不良與主動脈閉鎖；導管關閉後急速惡化；術前需前列腺素E1與呼吸器。

points.en: Transposition of great arteries: aorta from RV, pulmonary artery from LV; severe cyanosis if little mixing; PGE1 and balloon atrial septostomy; arterial switch repair.
points.zh: 大動脈轉位：主動脈出自右心室、肺動脈出自左心室；混合少則重度發紺；使用PGE1與氣球心房中膈造口；動脈調換術修補。

points.en: Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection: pulmonary veins fail to reach LA; rapid decline with obstruction; repaired in early infancy.
points.zh: 全肺靜脈異位連接：肺靜脈未接左心房；阻塞時快速惡化；嬰兒早期修補。

points.en: Truncus arteriosus: single vessel overrides both ventricles; HF and variable cyanosis; repair in first months.
points.zh: 永存動脈幹：單一血管跨接兩心室；HF與不等程度發紺；數月內修補。

points.en: General defect care: monitor respiratory status, reverse Trendelenburg for work of breathing, watch for hypercyanotic spells, daily weight, high-calorie nutrition.
points.zh: 缺損一般照護：監測呼吸、以反Trendelenburg減少呼吸功、注意缺氧發作、每日體重、高熱量營養。

heading.zh: 心導管檢查與心臟手術

points.en: Pre-procedure: accurate height/weight, iodine allergy, signs of infection, mark and record distal pulses, baseline O2 saturation.
points.zh: 術前：測準確身高體重、碘過敏史、感染徵象、標記並記錄遠端脈搏、基礎血氧。

points.en: Post-procedure: monitor 4 hours; check pulses, color and warmth below site (coolness = arterial obstruction); keep leg flat 4-6 h (venous) or 6-8 h (arterial).
points.zh: 術後：監測4小時；檢查穿刺處以下脈搏、顏色與溫度（變冷＝動脈阻塞）；靜脈入路平躺4-6小時、動脈入路6-8小時。

points.en: If bleeding: apply continuous direct pressure at or just above the site and report.
points.zh: 若出血：於穿刺處或其上方持續直接加壓並通報。

points.en: Cardiac surgery postop: watch temperature and sepsis, aseptic technique, pain control, rest, early parent contact.
points.zh: 心臟手術後：監測體溫與敗血症、無菌技術、止痛、休息、盡早親子接觸。

points.en: Home care after surgery: avoid crowds 2 weeks, no falls risk activities 2-4 weeks, no lotions/powders on incision, no new foods for infants, no PE for 2 months, dental visits with antibiotic notice.
points.zh: 術後居家：2週避免人群、2-4週避免易跌倒活動、傷口勿擦乳液或粉、嬰兒不加新食物、2個月不上體育課、看牙需告知心臟病史。

points.en: Autoimmune inflammation appearing 2-6 weeks after untreated/partly treated group A beta-hemolytic strep pharyngitis; mitral valve most affected.
points.zh: 未治療或不完全治療之A群乙型溶血性鏈球菌咽炎後2-6週發生的自體免疫發炎；最常侵犯二尖瓣。

points.en: Jones: major = carditis, polyarthritis, chorea, erythema marginatum, subcutaneous nodules; minor = fever, arthralgia, raised ESR/CRP, prolonged PR. Need 2 major or 1 major + 2 minor plus evidence of strep (ASO titer).
points.zh: Jones準則：主要＝心臟炎、多發性關節炎、舞蹈症、環形紅斑、皮下結節；次要＝發燒、關節痛、ESR/CRP升高、PR間期延長。需2主要或1主要+2次要，加上鏈球菌感染證據（ASO）。

points.en: Care: bed rest in acute phase, antibiotics, anti-inflammatories after diagnosis confirmed, seizure precautions for chorea, long-term antibiotic prophylaxis.
points.zh: 照護：急性期臥床、抗生素、確診後才給抗發炎藥、舞蹈症時癲癇防護、長期抗生素預防。

points.en: Acute systemic vasculitis of unknown cause; coronary aneurysm is the major complication.
points.zh: 原因不明的急性全身性血管炎；主要併發症為冠狀動脈瘤。

points.en: Acute: fever, conjunctival hyperemia, cracked red lips/strawberry tongue, swollen hands/feet with red palms/soles, rash, cervical lymphadenopathy, irritability.
points.zh: 急性期：發燒、結膜充血、嘴唇乾裂紅腫/草莓舌、手足腫脹與掌蹠紅斑、皮疹、頸部淋巴結腫大、易怒。

points.en: Subacute: peeling fingertips/toes, joint pain, thrombocytosis. Convalescent: looks normal, labs still abnormal.
points.zh: 亞急性期：指趾脫皮、關節痛、血小板增多。恢復期：外觀正常，檢驗仍異常。

points.en: Treatment: high-dose IVIG (blood product) plus aspirin; delay MMR/varicella vaccines 11 months after IVIG; no aspirin if exposed to chickenpox or flu.
points.zh: 治療：高劑量IVIG（血液製品）加阿斯匹靈；IVIG後11個月內延後MMR/水痘疫苗；接觸水痘或流感時避免阿斯匹靈。

critical_points.en: Early HF signs in infants: tachycardia, tachypnea, scalp sweating, fatigue, sudden weight gain.
critical_points.zh: 嬰兒HF早期徵象：心跳過速、呼吸過速、頭皮出汗、疲倦、體重突增。

critical_points.en: Hold digoxin if apical pulse <90-110 (infant/young child) or <70 (older child); therapeutic 0.8-2 ng/mL.
critical_points.zh: 心尖脈嬰幼兒 <90-110、較大兒童 <70 時暫停毛地黃；治療濃度0.8-2 ng/mL。

critical_points.en: Hypokalemia from furosemide increases digoxin toxicity risk.
critical_points.zh: furosemide造成的低血鉀增加毛地黃中毒風險。

critical_points.en: Do not repeat a digoxin dose if the child vomits; do not double missed doses; give 1 h before or 2 h after feeds; never mix in food.
critical_points.zh: 嘔吐後勿補給毛地黃；漏服勿加倍；餵食前1小時或後2小時給藥；勿混入食物。

critical_points.en: Weigh diapers to measure infant urine output accurately.
critical_points.zh: 以秤尿布方式準確測量嬰兒尿量。

critical_points.en: Tet spell: calm infant, knee-chest position, 100% O2, morphine, IV fluids, notify provider.
critical_points.zh: 缺氧發作：安撫、膝胸臥位、100%氧氣、嗎啡、靜脈輸液、通知醫師。

critical_points.en: Coarctation: higher BP in arms than legs, weak femoral pulses.
critical_points.zh: 主動脈縮窄：上肢血壓高於下肢、股動脈脈搏弱。

critical_points.en: PDA: machinery murmur, bounding pulses, wide pulse pressure.
critical_points.zh: PDA：機械樣雜音、脈搏洪大、脈壓增寬。

critical_points.en: AV canal defect is the most common cardiac defect in Down syndrome.
critical_points.zh: 房室管缺損為唐氏症最常見心臟缺損。

critical_points.en: Ductal-dependent lesions (hypoplastic left heart, TGA) need prostaglandin E1 to keep the ductus open.
critical_points.zh: 導管依賴型缺損（左心發育不全、大動脈轉位）需前列腺素E1維持導管開放。

critical_points.en: After cardiac catheterization: coolness or absent pulses distal to the site = arterial obstruction; bleeding = direct pressure and call.
critical_points.zh: 心導管後：穿刺遠端冰冷或脈搏消失＝動脈阻塞；出血＝直接加壓並通報。

critical_points.en: After cardiac surgery: no lotions/powders on incision, avoid crowds 2 weeks.
critical_points.zh: 心臟手術後：傷口不擦乳液/粉、2週避免人群。

critical_points.en: Rheumatic fever: ask about sore throat/fever in prior 2 months; ASO titer confirms strep; Jones criteria; do not give salicylates before diagnosis (masks arthritis).
critical_points.zh: 風濕熱：詢問前2個月咽痛/發燒史；ASO確認鏈球菌；Jones準則；確診前不給水楊酸（會掩蓋關節炎）。

critical_points.en: Kawasaki acute stage: conjunctival hyperemia, strawberry tongue, swollen red hands/feet; desquamation comes later (subacute).
critical_points.zh: 川崎病急性期：結膜充血、草莓舌、手足紅腫；脫皮出現較晚（亞急性）。

critical_points.en: Kawasaki: IVIG + aspirin; delay MMR/varicella 11 months after IVIG.
critical_points.zh: 川崎病：IVIG+阿斯匹靈；IVIG後延後MMR/水痘疫苗11個月。

mnemonics.en: Tetralogy of Fallot = 'PROV': Pulmonary stenosis, Right ventricular hypertrophy, Overriding aorta, VSD.
mnemonics.zh: 法洛氏四重症記憶「PROV」：肺動脈狹窄、右心室肥大、主動脈騎跨、VSD。

mnemonics.en: Rheumatic fever major criteria 'J-O-N-E-S': Joints, O (heart), Nodules, Erythema marginatum, Sydenham chorea.
mnemonics.zh: 風濕熱主要準則「JONES」：關節炎、心臟炎(O)、結節、環形紅斑、舞蹈症(Sydenham)。

stem.en: An infant with a ventricular septal defect is on digoxin. Apical pulse before the dose is 88 beats/min. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 患有VSD的嬰兒使用毛地黃，給藥前心尖脈為88次/分。護理師應如何處置？

options.en: Give the dose and recheck in 1 hour
Hold the dose and notify the provider

rationale.en: Digoxin is held when the infant's apical rate is below about 90-110/min because of bradycardia risk; notify the provider. Dose is never self-adjusted and should not be mixed with feeds.
rationale.zh: 嬰兒心尖脈低於約90-110次/分應暫停毛地黃以防心搏過緩並通知醫師；不可自行減量，也不混入餵食。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statements by parents show correct understanding of home digoxin administration? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 下列哪些家長說法顯示正確了解毛地黃居家給藥？（複選）

options.en: "I will give it 1 hour before or 2 hours after feeding."
options.zh: 「我會在餵食前1小時或後2小時給藥。」

options.en: "If he vomits, I will repeat the dose."
"I will call if more than 2 doses are missed."
"I will use the measuring device from the pharmacist."
"I will keep it in a locked cabinet."

rationale.en: Do not repeat a dose after vomiting; the other statements are correct home-care teaching.
rationale.zh: 嘔吐後不可補給；其餘皆為正確衛教。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A 6-month-old with tetralogy of Fallot becomes cyanotic and tachypneic while crying during a blood draw. What is the nurse's first action?
stem.zh: 6個月大法洛氏四重症嬰兒於抽血哭鬧時發紺並呼吸急促。護理師首要行動為何？

options.en: Place in knee-chest position and calm the infant
options.zh: 採膝胸臥位並安撫嬰兒

options.en: Place in prone with legs extended

rationale.en: Knee-chest position increases systemic vascular resistance and venous return; calm, 100% O2, morphine and IV fluids follow as prescribed.
rationale.zh: 膝胸臥位增加全身血管阻力與靜脈回流；並依醫囑給100%氧氣、嗎啡與靜脈輸液，同時減少刺激。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: On assessment of a child with suspected coarctation of the aorta, which finding does the nurse expect?
stem.zh: 評估疑似主動脈縮窄的兒童，預期出現哪項發現？

options.en: Strong femoral pulses and cool arms
options.zh: 股動脈脈搏強、上肢冰冷

options.en: Higher BP in the arms than in the legs

rationale.en: Coarctation produces upper-extremity hypertension with weak femoral pulses. Clubbing/squatting suggests tetralogy; machinery murmur suggests PDA.
rationale.zh: 縮窄造成上肢高血壓與股動脈脈搏弱；杵狀指/蹲踞見於法洛氏四重症；機械樣雜音見於PDA。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A child returns from cardiac catheterization via the femoral artery. Which finding needs immediate action?
stem.zh: 孩童經股動脈心導管檢查後返室。哪項發現需立即處理？

options.en: Pedal pulse on the affected leg weak and foot cool and pale
options.zh: 患側足背脈搏弱、足部冰冷蒼白

rationale.en: A weak pulse with a cool pale extremity suggests arterial obstruction/clot and must be reported immediately.
rationale.zh: 脈搏弱且肢體冰冷蒼白提示動脈阻塞或血栓，需立即通報。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which findings support a diagnosis of rheumatic fever? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些發現支持風濕熱診斷？（複選）

options.en: Recent group A strep sore throat

rationale.en: Strawberry tongue and desquamation are Kawasaki features. The others are Jones criteria or evidence of strep infection.
rationale.zh: 草莓舌與脫皮為川崎病特徵；其餘為Jones準則或鏈球菌感染證據。

stem.en: A parent of a child receiving aspirin for Kawasaki disease asks what to report. Which is most important?
stem.zh: 接受阿斯匹靈治療川崎病的孩童家長詢問需通報什麼。何者最重要？

rationale.en: Aspirin with varicella or influenza risks Reye syndrome; the other findings are expected in Kawasaki recovery.
rationale.zh: 阿斯匹靈合併水痘或流感有Reye症候群風險；其他為川崎病恢復期預期表現。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A newborn with transposition of the great arteries is awaiting surgery. Which medication does the nurse expect to administer to maintain blood mixing?
stem.zh: 等待手術的大動脈轉位新生兒，預期給予何藥以維持血液混合？

rationale.en: PGE1 keeps the ductus arteriosus open. Indomethacin and ibuprofen close it.
rationale.zh: PGE1維持動脈導管開放；indomethacin與ibuprofen會使其關閉。
